body: Above roughly 40 nodes on one bus we start losing frames. Termination is correct and the harness is the CBL-900.
What bitrate are you running? The 400 defaults to 500 kbit/s and the datasheet caps a 40+ node bus at 250.
500 kbit/s. Dropping to 250 fixed it completely, thank you.
After rotating our API key every stored cursor returns 400 invalid_cursor. Is the key part of the cursor signature?
It is. Cursors are signed with the issuing key so they cannot outlive it. We are looking at scoping the signature to the org instead.
Green LEDs but the dashboard says offline for over an hour.
Green means power and link, not cloud connectivity. Check outbound 8883/tcp on the site firewall.
We hit 429 on /v1/telemetry/batch at about 300 requests per minute. Is that per key or per org?
Per key. Split the ingest across two keys or ask support to raise the ceiling.
Orbit 4.8 is live. Highlights: offline queue for field reports, passkey sign-in in beta, and a 84% cut in sign-in latency.
